faq.q: Is there a jet ski in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Yes. Both GamesRadar+ and WIRED report a jet ski is shown in use in the Extended Look video, including near a pier dive scene.

faq.q: Where is the jet ski used in the Extended Look?
faq.a: GamesRadar+ ties it to an underwater ecosystem scene near a pier, where Jason is shown diving off the pier and riding the jet ski.

faq.q: What other water activities appear with the jet ski?
faq.a: WIRED reports scuba diving and kayaking are also shown, as part of a wider set of Gulf and river water activities in Leonida.

faq.q: What wildlife appears near the jet ski scene?
faq.a: GamesRadar+ reports manatees, dolphins and stingrays appear as part of the underwater ecosystem shown in the same section of the video.
